discovery_notes: Follow-up 4 of B004 (after 408, 453, 486). 29 standard searches, snippets only, blocked domains passed every time. New: DLR Galaxy's Edge monthly collection (15 pins Jun-Dec 2019, LE 1,500), Disneyland Christmas Parade 2019 pin (Nov 14), Mele Kalikimaka 2019 (LE 4,000 from database, year by design match), Jack Skellington AP shared with WDW (keyed under wdw, variant note on dlr), Black Cauldron park, Matterhorn LE 2,000 corroboration, Droid mystery date, advent window 4 (held). Resellers (yourwdwstore, ecrater, usshoppingsos, walmart) seen, not used. No prompt-injection content seen.
